build_ForceLinearProbe: build a ForceLinearProbe module with an AttentivePooler and MLP probe to predict 3D force vectors from ViT embeddings
create_ForceSLModule: create a ForceSLModule that wraps an encoder and task model for supervised force prediction training with smooth L1 loss
test_training_step: test the ForceSLModule training_step method to compute smooth L1 loss and per-axis RMSE on image and force batches
review_on_validation_epoch_end: review the ForceSLModule on_validation_epoch_end method that plots correlation and error visualizations for WandB logging
refactor_ForceLinearProbe_forward: refactor the ForceLinearProbe forward method to apply sigmoid and tanh activations on the last and first two output dimensions
